passages.neutron-stars: A neutron star is a stellar remnant that marks the final stage in the life cycle of a massive star. When gi___ stars hea____ than t__ Sun exh____ their fu__, their co__ implodes. Wh__ remains i_ a sph___ so den____ packed that its gravity crushes protons and electrons together, forming a mass composed almost entirely of neutrons. These stars are only about 12 miles (20 km) in diameter, yet they contain more mass than the Sun. This means just a teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh billions of tons.

questions.prompt: Question 31: complete gi___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ant → giant。giant starsは「巨大な星」。前文のmassive starを受ける形容詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 32: complete hea____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：vier → heavier。heavier thanは「〜より重い」。thanを伴う比較級です。

questions.prompt: Question 33: complete t__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：he → the。the Sunは「太陽」。この文のように太陽を指すときは定冠詞theを付けます。

questions.prompt: Question 34: complete exh____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：aust → exhaust。exhaust their fuelは「燃料を使い果たす」。starsが複数なのでexhaustです。

questions.prompt: Question 35: complete fu__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：el → fuel。fuelは「燃料」。核融合反応などで使われる物質を述べる文脈です。

questions.prompt: Question 36: complete co__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：re → core。coreは「中心核」。their core implodesで中心部が内側へ崩壊することを述べます。

questions.prompt: Question 37: complete Wh__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：at → What。What remainsは「残るもの」。whatが名詞節を作り、文頭なので大文字です。

questions.prompt: Question 38: complete i_. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：s → is。What remains is ...と、主語である名詞節に単数のisを使います。

questions.prompt: Question 39: complete sph___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ere → sphere。a sphereは「球」。中性子星の形を表す単数名詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 40: complete den____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sely → densely。densely packedは「高密度に詰まった」。packedを修飾する副詞です。
